criteria.name: Data Completeness
criteria.feedback: Your submission includes all required columns and product entries, with no missing or incomplete data. Excellent job meeting all data completeness requirements for this assignment.

criteria.name: Data Accuracy
criteria.feedback: Most of your calculations are correct, but there is a small error in the 'Keyboard' row where Total Revenue does not match Units Sold times Unit Price. Be sure to double-check each row for simple mistakes to improve accuracy.

criteria.name: Organization and Formatting
criteria.feedback: Your CSV is well-organized and easy to read, with clear headers and consistently formatted rows that follow all required structure guidelines. Excellent work on ensuring readability and organization for sales data evaluation.
